title: Club Orchard and Tony Fougerat's Dixie Ramblers
summary: Photo of Tony Fougerat's band at the orchard-themed Club Orchard on Canal Street; dancers Doreen and Ellis and Honey Wagner.

blocks.x: What is that logo on the bandstand? CO.

CD? Is it D? Can't remember. Oh, oh. This was at the Club Orchard. That's what that stood for. Oh, yeah. Club Orchard. Right at the corner of Charters and Canal. Yeah. Tony Fougerat. And Tony and his Dixie Ramblers. Tony and his Dixie Ramblers. Yeah, yeah.
And what are the saxophone players' names again? I'm not sure.
Yeah, on alto and Marshall Farrell on tenor. I see.
Y'all played outside in a courtyard, it looks like. Is that?
No, that was the bandstand. And that was decorated like an orchard, you know, in other words. Oh, I see. Uh-huh.
I thought maybe it was really open air.
Oh, there was a gorgeous team, Doreen and Ellis. That's that team, you know, that I first showed you the picture. Christmas card. Isn't she beautiful?
And sweet and kind and... Do you know who this gal is? No, but I'd like to. Honey Wagner. Mm-hmm.
She's teaching dancing right here in Metair. Mm-hmm. Sweet little old gal.
